verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents built-in support for agents from several model vendors (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok) plus open-source BrowserUse, and offers both open-source frameworks and model-native agents, so it is not locked to one vendor. There is no evidence that developers can plug in an arbitrary LLM provider or their own API keys, including for the open-source HyperAgent framework. Missing for 10: documented bring-your-own-provider or own-API-key configuration, custom or self-hosted model support in HyperAgent, and independent corroboration.
